[P2] 老橡树
图文作者：鲍伯·格莱厄姆
改编者：B.G.丹吉尔
译者：波妞

很久很久以前，一位贫穷的伐木工人和他的妻子
来到一片大森林的边缘。伐木工用双臂环抱着森林里
最古老的一棵橡树，久久地倾听着橡树的低声细语。

版权所有 侵权必究
法国巴亚儿童出版社："好故事丛书"
法国巴亚儿童出版社

[P3] 伐木工的妻子罗斯玛丽马上就要生小宝宝了。于是，伐木工拿出最锋利的斧子，砍倒了这棵老橡树。他用橡木给自己和家人造了个房子。他还做了一张桌子、几把椅子和一个沉重的橡木箱子。

[P4] 罗斯玛丽用橡木做了一个会“咔嗒咔嗒”响的木娃娃，这是为即将出生的宝宝准备的。
“看！”罗斯玛丽说，“大的这个娃娃是我。”她边说边“咯吱”一声拧开了娃娃，“中间这个是我们的孩子。”
“大的这个是你，”伐木工说，“中间这个是我们的孩子，那最小的这个是谁？”罗斯玛丽说：“以后你就知道了！”不久后，他们的孩子就出生了，他们给她取名瓦奥莱特。

[P5] 瓦奥莱特大部分时间都呆在森林深处，她在森林的苔藓地上学会了走路。瓦奥莱特在慢慢长大，她总是随身带着自己的木娃娃。回家的时候，她的篮子里会装着满满的野生草莓、藏红花、蛙兰和勿忘我。她还会收集种子和橡子，把它们装在口袋里带回家。

[P6] 又过了很多年，瓦奥莱特长大并且结婚了。生活开始变得不一样了。
伐木工一家看到，山那边的“钢筋水泥森林”正在慢慢逼近。
在春天的某一天，他们看到一队大卡车和拖拉机朝自己家这边开了过来。
车上装着笨重的机器装备。

[P7] 瓦奥莱特抓起自己的木娃娃就往森林深处飞奔而去。她把自己秘密收藏的种子和橡子全都拿了出来，小心翼翼地装进了最小的那个娃娃的肚子里。然后，她把最小的娃娃的肚子紧紧地合上，装在中间那个娃娃里，最后把最大的娃娃套在了最外面。
接着，瓦奥莱特把自己所有的秘密都装进了上锁的橡木箱子里，然后用尽全力把钥匙扔到了森林深处。

[P8] 森林被砍伐了，所有的树木都被运走了。

[P9] 瓦奥莱特的女儿出生了。他们给她取名莉莉。他们用那棵老橡树剩下的最后一块木头，给莉莉做了一个摇篮。

[P10] 瓦奥莱特是在森林的苔藓地上学会走路的。但是她的女儿莉莉，却在水泥地上踏出了人生第一步。曾经长满了大树的茂密森林，如今变成了一大片林立的楼房。

[P11] 这片玻璃、石头和金属组成的“森林”完全没有秘密可言。最悲伤的是，莉莉没有秘密。
莉莉的妈妈瓦奥莱特想到了一个主意。她打算把自己的秘密给女儿——那些她锁在橡木箱子里好多年年的秘密。但是橡木箱子锁着呢，钥匙现在不知道躺在这座城市地下的哪里。

[P12] 于是，外婆罗斯玛丽说：“我可以用我的小刀凿一把木头钥匙。”“但是已经没有木头了。”瓦奥莱特叹气道，“我们已经用最后一块木头给莉莉做了摇篮了。”“还有呢。”老伐木工说完，从自己的斧子柄上锯下了一块木头，“反正我也用不着这个了。”

[P13] 瓦奥莱特用罗斯玛丽做的钥匙打开了箱子。她把三个木娃娃拿了出来，说：“莉莉，秘密都是很特别的，它如果被公开了，就不再是秘密了。它们会像一阵风一样消失得无影无踪。如果你想保留这个秘密，那就永远都不要打开最小的那个娃娃。”

[P14] 谁能这样保守一个秘密呀！反正莉莉是不能的！莉莉“咯吱”一声拧开了最小的娃娃。里面是来自以前那片老树林各个地方的种子。突然，一阵风吹来。妈妈的秘密像一阵风一样消失了。

[P15] 第二天，莉莉、妈妈瓦奥莱特还有外婆罗斯玛丽简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。现在谁都可以看到瓦奥莱特的秘密了。
来自老树林的种子在各处的水泥缝里开出了花。

[P16] 但是，莉莉、妈妈和外婆不知道的是，飞走的种子里，有一粒来自老橡树。现在，在他们家不远处，一棵小橡树正在慢慢长大。

[P2] Old Oak Tree
Illustrator and Author: Bob Graham
Adapter: B.G. Danjel
Translator: Bōniū

Long, long ago, a poor lumberjack and his wife
arrived at the edge of a great forest. The lumberjack wrapped his arms around the oldest oak tree in the forest, listening for a long time to the tree's soft whispers.

All rights reserved. Infringement will be prosecuted.
Bayard Children's Publishing: "Good Story Series"
Bayard Children's Publishing

[P3] The lumberjack's wife, Rosemary, was about to give birth to a baby. So, the lumberjack took out his sharpest axe and cut down the old oak tree. He used the oak wood to build a house for himself and his family. He also made a table, several chairs, and a heavy oak chest.

[P4] Rosemary made a wooden doll that went 'click-clack' with oak wood, prepared for the baby who was about to be born.
"Look!" Rosemary said, "The big doll is me." As she said this, she 'cracked' open the doll with a twist, "The one in the middle is our child."
"The big one is you," the woodcutter said, "The one in the middle is our child, but who is the smallest one?" Rosemary replied, "You'll find out soon enough!" Soon after, their child was born, and they named her Violet.

[P5] Violet spent most of her time deep in the forest, where she learned to walk on the mossy ground. As Violet grew, she always carried her wooden doll with her. When she returned home, her basket would be full of wild strawberries, saffron, frog orchids, and forget-me-nots. She also collected seeds and acorns, putting them in her pockets to take home.

[P6] Many years passed, and Violet grew up and got married. Life began to change.
The lumberjack family saw that the 'forest of steel and concrete' on the other side of the mountain was slowly approaching.
One spring day, they saw a convoy of large trucks and tractors coming toward their home.
The vehicles were loaded with heavy machinery.

[P7] Violet grabbed her wooden doll and ran off into the depths of the forest. She took out all the seeds and acorns she had secretly collected, carefully placing them inside the smallest doll. Then, she tightly closed the smallest doll's belly, placed it inside the middle doll, and finally put the largest doll over the top.
Next, Violet put all her secrets into a locked oak box, and then threw the key with all her might deep into the forest.

[P8] The forest was cut down, and all the trees were taken away.

[P9] Violet's daughter was born. They named her Lily. They used the last piece of wood from the old oak tree to make a cradle for Lily.

[P10] Violet learned to walk on the mossy ground of the forest. But her daughter Lily took her first steps on concrete. The once-dense forest, full of tall trees, has now become a vast area of towering buildings.

[P11] This forest made of glass, stone, and metal has no secrets at all. The saddest thing is, Lily has no secrets.
Lily's mother, Violette, had an idea. She planned to give her secrets to her daughter—those secrets she had locked in the oak box for many, many years. But the oak box was locked, and the key was now nowhere to be found beneath this city.

[P12] Then, Grandma Rosemary said, "I can use my little knife to carve a wooden key." "But there's no wood left," Violet sighed. "We've already used the last piece of wood to make a cradle for Lily." "There's still some," the old lumberjack said, cutting a piece of wood from his axe handle. "Anyway, I don't need this anymore."

[P13] Violet opened the box with the key made by Rosemary. She took out the three wooden dolls and said, "Lily, secrets are very special. If they are revealed, they are no longer secrets. They will disappear like the wind. If you want to keep this secret, never open the smallest doll."

[P14] Who could keep a secret like that! Anyway, Lily couldn't! Lily 'click' opened the smallest doll. Inside were seeds from all over the old forest. Suddenly, a wind blew. Mom's secret disappeared like the wind.

[P15] The next day, Lily, her mother Violet, and her grandmother Rosemary couldn't believe their eyes. Now everyone could see Violet's secret.
The seeds from the old forest had sprouted flowers in the cracks of the concrete everywhere.

[P16] But Lily, her mom, and her grandma didn't know that among the seeds that flew away, one came from the old oak tree. Now, not far from their home, a little oak tree is growing slowly.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《老橡树》的封面页，展示了书名、作者、改编者、译者及出版社信息，画面中一个小女孩在大树下采摘花朵。
[P2] 本页为绘本《老橡树》的扉页，展示了书名、作者及创作团队信息，并以文字叙述了很久以前一位贫穷的伐木工人和他的妻子来到森林边缘，伐木工拥抱并倾听一棵古老橡树的故事开端。
[P3] 伐木工的妻子即将生产，他砍倒老橡树，用橡木为家人建造房屋，并制作了家具和箱子。
[P4] 罗斯玛丽用橡木制作了一个会响的木娃娃，并向丈夫解释娃娃代表家庭成员，预示即将出生的孩子。不久后，他们的女儿瓦奥莱特出生了。
[P5] 瓦奥莱特在森林中长大，她随身带着木娃娃，常在苔藓地上行走，采集野生草莓、藏红花、蛙兰、勿忘我等植物，并收集种子和橡子带回家。
[P6] 瓦奥莱特长大结婚后，伐木工一家发现山那边的现代城市正在逼近，一天他们看到载着重型机械的卡车和拖拉机正朝自家驶来。
[P7] 瓦奥莱特将自己收藏的种子和橡子藏进套娃，并把所有秘密锁进橡木箱后，将钥匙扔进森林深处，画面中她正抱着套娃奔跑。
[P8] 画面展示了一辆巨型卡车运载着巨大的原木，背景是空旷的土地，下方文字说明森林已被砍伐，所有树木都被运走。
[P9] 瓦奥莱特的女儿莉莉出生了，家人用老橡树的最后一块木头为她制作了一个摇篮，画面温馨地展现了全家围在摇篮旁的场景。
[P10] 画面描绘了城市化对森林的侵蚀，瓦奥莱特在森林中学会走路，而她的女儿莉莉则在水泥地上迈出人生第一步，曾经的茂密森林已变成高楼林立的城市。
[P11] 画面描绘了一个被玻璃、石头和金属构成的现代城市公园，瓦奥莱特为女儿莉莉没有秘密而悲伤，并计划将自己锁在橡木箱中的秘密传给女儿，但钥匙已不知所踪。
[P12] 为了给莉莉制作木头钥匙，家人在家中讨论可用的木材，老伐木工最终从自己的斧柄上锯下一块木头，以延续瓦奥莱特的秘密传承。
[P13] 瓦奥莱特用新做的钥匙打开橡木箱，取出套娃，并告诉女儿莉莉秘密的珍贵，叮嘱她永远不要打开最小的娃娃。
[P14] 莉莉无法保守秘密，她拧开了最小的娃娃，里面是老树林的种子，随后一阵风吹来，妈妈的秘密随之消失。
[P15] 第二天，莉莉、妈妈瓦奥莱特和外婆罗斯玛丽发现，老树林的种子在城市水泥地的缝隙中长出了花朵，秘密已公之于众。
[P16] 画面描绘了城市公园中，莉莉、妈妈和外婆坐在长椅上，而远处草地上一棵小橡树正在生长，暗示着老橡树的种子在城市中生根发芽。
